headline: Indian markets set for steady opening; NSE IPO sees record demand as crude prices ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: NSE IPO draws record-breaking demand of Rs 90,000 crore, becoming a major market highlight.
Easing crude oil prices provide a positive catalyst for Indian equity sentiment.
Global cues are supportive following a Nasdaq rally and positive signals from Gift Nifty.
Sensex and Nifty show signs of recovery after six consecutive weeks of declines.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 564 points in the previous session, with Nifty closing above the 23,400 level.
Two SME IPOs, Anand Seamless and Himalaya Nutravedics, open for subscription today.
Polycab shares experienced a sharp 17% slide following the launch of competitor Ultravolt.
Brokerages JPMorgan and Bernstein issued positive outlooks for L&T and NTPC Green respectively.
summary: Indian markets are poised for a steady start as the Sensex and Nifty rebound from a six-week losing streak, supported by easing crude oil prices. Investor sentiment is further boosted by record-breaking demand for the NSE IPO and positive brokerage upgrades for L&T and NTPC Green. However, Polycab remains under pressure following a significant 17% decline.
